blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: The current holder-facing KESm token has no direct governance-controlled blacklist, freeze, pause, seizure, arbitrary-account burn, or transfer-hook restriction. Broker/exchange burn and Celo-VM gas debiting are protocol-scoped, not governance holder-freeze controls. Timelocked proxy upgrade authority is recorded in mint-authority evidence but is not itself a currently executable holder-freeze surface. This direct conclusion does not suppress reserve-derived upstream exposure.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified 2026-08-08 at Celo block 74317848. KESm 0x456a3d042c0dbd3db53d5489e98dfb038553b0d0 still returned Mento Timelock 0x890db8a597940165901372dd7db61c9f246e2147 as owner, Broker 0x777a8255ca72412f0d706dc03c9d1987306b4cad, validators 0xaeb865bca93ddc8f47b8e29f40c5399ce34d0c58, and a zero exchange; its implementation remained verified StableTokenV2 0x434563b0604be100f04b7ae485bcafe3c9d8850e. Verified transfer paths have no blacklist, freeze, pause, seizure, arbitrary-holder burn, allowlist, or governance transfer hook. Broker/exchange burn is caller-scoped and debitGasFees is Celo-VM scoped. Mento governance can replace implementation only through the observed 172800-second timelock, so current direct blacklistability is false while deployment posture remains restrictable. USDC, USDT, EURC, and related shared-reserve exposures can impair backing but cannot restrict KESm balances and are therefore dependency risk, not an inherited direct-access verdict.

oracleRisk.summary: At Celo block 78986505, KESm's Broker/BiPoolManager USDm/KESm ConstantSum exchange 0x89de88b8eb790de26f4649f543cb6893d93635c728ac857f0926e842fb0d298b uses KES/USD feed 0xbacee37d31b9f022ef5d232b9fd53f05a531c169, one ChainlinkRelayerV1 reporter 0x4920101408d129a1a7b33fb0eca4fb0233fd00d4, and one configured Chainlink aggregator 0x0826492a24b1dbd1d8fcb4701b38c557ce685e9d. getRates and medianRate agree on 7710992019123260000000/1e24; medianTimestamp is 1790887031. Effective report expiry and bucket reset are 360 seconds, minimumReports is 1, and spread is 1%. MedianDeltaBreaker is enabled at 4% with a 900-second reset cooldown; ValueDeltaBreaker is disabled. The sorted-list median of one relayer is not independent medianization or failover. Stale reports invalidate ConstantSum quotes; BreakerBox suspends execution rather than substituting a second source. This evidenced single-live-source topology retains the existing Mento single-source-or-laggy convention; it does not assert the pinned report was stale.

branchApplicability.rationale: KESm is explicitly reserve-backed in the pinned issuer configuration, not one of the GBPm/CHFm/JPYm CDP assets. The enumerated pinned Broker mint/burn exchange has external price authority but no borrower-specific liquidation engine. Score this authority as coin-price-feed/top-level-only; branch rows and liquidationDelaySec are not applicable. A 900-second breaker reset cooldown or 360-second report expiry is not a liquidation delay. This review covers canonical Celo exchange pricing and does not classify separate bridge control or remote-chain liquidity.
